decision: Driver: Reprimand (Driving). This is the driver's 2nd reprimand of the season. Reason The Stewards reviewed in-car video evidence and determined that Car 87 reversed in the pit lane under its own power. This is expressly prohibited under Article B1.6.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations. We therefore imposed a driving reprimand on the driver of Car 87 (BEA).
fact: Car 87 reversed in the Pit Lane.
offence: Breach of Article B1.6.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
